avis.titre: You need to read the label!
avis.texte: This IS NOT a daily cleanser! It's main purpose is to EXFOLIATE with glycolic acid. If you're using this more than 2-3 times per week, you will experience irritation. When you begin a new skin care regimen, your skin will experience "purging" as well. The cleanser strips away dead skin cells to regenerate new skin cells which in turn draws everything trapped deep in the pores to the surface. This will come in the form of small white heads. If they're painless, not red and sore like legitimate pimples, there's no need to be concerned. Also, washing your face activates your sebaceous glands, making your skin a bit oily by the end of the day but you want those natural oils, so just blot your face or give it a gentle rinse. In my opinion, this cleanser is fantastic but you need to be aware that some effects at first are simply from beginning a new regimen and not a negative effect from the product itself. I would recommend to use the toner with the cleanser followed by a daily moisturizer. My first 2 weeks with it were slightly rocky from what I've already mentioned but after a month, my skin is much clearer, pores are definitely reduced and hyperpigmentation from past break outs are almost gone or significantly faded. I have also stopped using powders and foundations, I don't really need it plus keeping my skin clean is expediting the process.
